# Welcome to the nCompass Developer Community


[Website](https://ncompass.tech/)[Docs](https://docs.ncompass.tech/)[Open Source Repo](https://github.com/nCompass-tech/ncompass)Support


A forum for developers to collaborate, share knowledge, and discuss nCompass Technologies’ developer tools.


---


### Getting Started


**Introduce yourself**
Add your picture and a short bio to[your profile](https://chatgpt.com/my/preferences/account) . Let others know what you’re working on and what topics you’re interested in.


**Explore the community**
Start by[browsing discussions](https://chatgpt.com/latest) . When you find something interesting or helpful, use the to show appreciation.


**Contribute**
Comment, share insights, ask questions, or offer feedback. Before posting, please review the[Community Guidelines](https://chatgpt.com/faq) .


> Need help or have a suggestion? Ask in **[Site Feedback](https://community.ncompass.tech/c/site-feedback/2)** or[contact the admins](https://chatgpt.com/about) .
